data.title: Understanding River Overflow Events
data.passage: Heavy rain falls constantly over the mountains. Rivers rise rapidly because the ground cannot absorb all the moisture. Water spills over the muddy riverbanks. Fields and roads become completely covered in deep water. Therefore, people living near the valley must move to higher ground.
